title: Unique Koszul-normalized exterior-to-self-Tor comparison
statement: For a commutative ring A, an ideal I, and n a natural number, let C be the A-module underlying the nth exterior power over A/I of I/I² and T=Tor_n^A(A/I,A/I). There is a unique A-linear morphism c:C -> T with the following normalization. For every finite tuple g:Fin r -> I, projective resolution P of A/I, and chain lift a:K_A(g) -> P of the quotient augmentation, a degree-n wedge v tensored with 1 is a cycle. Under the resolution computation T ≅ H_n(P tensor_A A/I), c sends the wedge of the conormal classes of the linear combinations of g with coefficients v to the image of that cycle under a tensor 1. Here the Koszul complex is [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex]. The definition selfTorConormalComparison selects this uniquely determined c; it does not choose an unspecified existence witness.
